example.title: Cinema lobby building with a curving glass tower on the Promenade
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A c. 1990 cinema on a shopping street: a white streamline front with a curving glass and steel corner tower lit at night, a thin cantilevered canopy and the cinema name in big red letters, palms along the walk. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
